reviewed_sources.name: Cryptic Bytes
reviewed_sources.current_role: Reproduction/control and cross-dataset comparison; not first hash-rate evaluation

reviewed_sources.name: WebAssembly Diversification for Malware Evasion
reviewed_sources.evidence: Sections 5.3 and 6.3, Table 4; pool validity and nominal 1000-second rate measurements
reviewed_sources.current_role: Methodological reference; recovered inputs retain reconstruction limitations

reviewed_sources.name: Proof-of-Theft
reviewed_sources.evidence: Main paper Section 6 RQs concern graph simplification and miner detection; supplementary.pdf (2 pages) contains theorem proof and graph examples. Artifact includes hashrate.js in cryptonight-hash baseline and obfuscated directories, so runtime measurement capability exists. Reviewed paper/supplement/README and artifact path inventory do not establish a published paired throughput/correctness result.
reviewed_sources.current_role: Priority 1: measure paired original and obfuscated uninstrumented modules, with verified hash outputs and algorithm-specific throughput; do not claim hashing was never run.

reviewed_sources.name: SWAMPED
reviewed_sources.evidence: Section IV.D / Table III: 74 samples, Node 22.19.0, Liftoff baseline JIT, no-op imported functions because JS artifacts absent, 1000 warm-up calls plus median of 100 calls per exported function. This is execution-time overhead, not a demonstrated complete mining hash throughput/output-validity benchmark. Public experimental_results tree lists detector scores and heat maps.
reviewed_sources.current_role: Priority 2: restore supported hashing host interfaces for cryptomining subset, then evaluate complete valid hashing; published seeds/transforms must be distinguished from our own generated variants.

reviewed_sources.name: MinerRay
reviewed_sources.evidence: Section 6.4 / Table 5 evaluates detector graph construction and scanning time/memory. Public README describes crawled Wasm samples and detection results. No paired obfuscation hashing-throughput benchmark identified in reviewed main paper/README/public file inventory.
reviewed_sources.current_role: Collected-code extension; check overlap with earlier mining papers and source/algorithm evidence before calling a binary newly evaluated.

reviewed_sources.name: MineSweeper
reviewed_sources.evidence: Section 6 / Table 10 reports Wasm vs asm.js hash rates on two CPUs and estimates throttling/profit impacts. This is not a systematic paired comparison of obfuscation methods over the whole released corpus.
reviewed_sources.current_role: Previously evaluated reference with potential additional sample/method coverage; not an unevaluated dataset.

reviewed_sources.name: WASMixer
reviewed_sources.hash_rate_scope: Mining D3 explicitly excluded in inspected arXiv:2308.03123v1; ESORICS 2024 full-text coverage unverified.
reviewed_sources.evidence: Sections 5.2/5.5 and Table 2: mining dataset D3 is explicitly excluded from runtime overhead evaluation owing to browser/JS dependencies. Section 5.3 checks outputs for D1/D2; Section 5.4.2 evaluates D3 detection. Scope: arXiv v1 only; a 2024 publication exists, with full-text evaluation not yet checked.
reviewed_sources.current_role: Complete valid hashing of a reused input plus SWAMPED-generated controls; not a runtime evaluation of WASMixer obfuscation methods or a worldwide-first claim.

novelty_audit.status: Documented evaluation gaps within the reviewed primary sources; worldwide first-evaluation claim not established
novelty_audit.primary_addition: Paired, correctness-verified complete hashing throughput for published obfuscated miners, extending detection-focused datasets and stub-based runtime evaluations
requirements: Trace exact binary reuse and prior benchmark coverage; reused input can support a new condition/method comparison but not a new-binary claim.
Separate Wasabi instrumentation overhead from obfuscation overhead.
Same algorithm/input/runtime/threads within pairs; repeat and report variation.
Without an original pair, report absolute hashing results but do not call a difference obfuscation overhead.
Do not infer absence of all earlier hashing runs from absence of a paper section.
